map.输血（成分血）剂量计算器 使用指南: Blood Transfusion (Component) Dose Calculator — User Guide
map.输血（成分血）剂量计算器。输入当前与目标 HGB 等指标，计算红细胞等成分血的输: A transfusion (blood component) dose calculator. Enter current and target HGB and other indices to compute the dose and expected increase for red cells and other components, for transfusion planning reference (follow medical advice).
map.按当前/目标 HGB 算红细胞单位数与预期提升（每 U 约 +10 g/L）: Compute red-cell unit count and expected increase from current/target HGB (each unit about +10 g/L)
map.血小板按单采/混合与体重算袋数，并用 CCI 判输注有效: Count platelet bags by apheresis/pooled and body weight, and use CCI to judge transfusion effectiveness
map.血浆（FFP）按 mL/kg 算总量，提升凝血因子约 15–20%: Compute total FFP volume by mL/kg, raising coagulation factors by about 15–20%
map.：红细胞：单位数=ceil((目标−当前)HGB/10)，每 U 悬液约提升 H: : Red cells: units=ceil((target−current)HGB/10), each unit of suspension raises HGB by about 10 g/L. Platelets: one apheresis bag (≈2.5×10¹¹) raises about 25–30×10⁹/L (70 kg), one pooled unit about 5×10⁹/L; CCI=(post−pre PLT)×body surface area/total platelets transfused, with 1h CCI>7.5 or 24h>4.5 indicating effectiveness. FFP: 10–15 mL/kg, each unit ≈200 mL.
map.：例（红细胞：当前 HGB=60、目标=90、体重 70）：需提升 30 g/L: : Example (red cells: current HGB=60, target=90, weight 70): need a 30 g/L rise → ceil(30/10)=3 U, expected HGB=60+3×10=90 g/L. Platelets (apheresis, current 10, target 40): a 30×10⁹/L gap needs about 1 bag (at 25–30 per bag) to reach target; check CCI afterwards to verify effectiveness.
map.每单位红细胞一定 +10 g/L 吗？: Does each unit of red cells always give +10 g/L?
map.是成人经验均值，受血容量、出血、溶血影响；儿童按体重换算（每 kg 约 4–6: That is an adult empirical average, affected by blood volume, bleeding and hemolysis; in children convert by weight (about 4–6 mL/kg of red cell suspension per kg raises about 10 g/L), and always rely on a post-transfusion CBC.
map.CCI 低说明什么？: What does a low CCI indicate?
map.1h CCI≤7.5 或 24h≤4.5 提示输注无效，常见于同种免疫、发热/感: 1h CCI≤7.5 or 24h≤4.5 indicates an ineffective transfusion, commonly from alloimmunization or platelet consumption due to fever/infection/bleeding/DIC; investigate the consumption cause and consider matched/HLA-compatible platelets.
